"""Int widths/uint64, aggregate results, multi-entry, pattern grammar."""
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from kbuild import *

CLI = [sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py']

def run_campaign(campaign):
    r = subprocess.run(CLI, input=json.dumps(campaign).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
    return json.loads(r.stdout)

types = [
    {"name": "W1", "kind": "int", "bits": 1},
    {"name": "W8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
    {"name": "W9", "kind": "int", "bits": 9},
    {"name": "W33", "kind": "int", "bits": 33},
    {"name": "U64", "kind": "int", "bits": 64},
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "Arr2", "kind": "array", "element": "W8", "size": 2},
    {"name": "Out", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["xs", "Arr2"], ["big", "U64"]]},
]
mod = {"name": "m", "params": [["a", "W1"], ["b", "W9"], ["c", "W33"], ["d", "U64"]],
       "result": ["o", "Out"], "requires": None}
# layout: a x0 w1; b x1 w2; c x2 w8; d x3 w8; o struct x4; xs arr x5; x6,x7; big x8 -> 9 vars
def mk(a, b, c, d, xs, big):
    objs = [("x0", le(a, 1)), ("x1", le(b, 2)), ("x2", le(c, 8)), ("x3", le(d, 8)),
            ("x6", le(xs[0], 1)), ("x7", le(xs[1], 1)), ("x8", le(big, 8))]
    return {"entry": "m", "ktest": b64(ktest(objs))}

campaign = {"types": types, "modules": [mod], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": None,
            "runs": [
                mk(1, 511, (1 << 33) - 1, (1 << 64) - 1, [1, 2], 12345678901234567890),
                mk(1, 511, (1 << 33) - 1, (1 << 64) - 1, [1, 2], 12345678901234567890),
                mk(2, 511, 1, 0, [1, 2], 0),   # a=2 out of range for W1 -> INVALID
                mk(0, 512, 1, 0, [1, 2], 0),   # b=512 needs 10 bits -> INVALID
            ]}
out = run_campaign(campaign)
plan = out['plans'][0]
assert plan['slots'] == [["x0", ["a"], 1], ["x1", ["b"], 2], ["x2", ["c"], 8],
                         ["x3", ["d"], 8], ["x6", ["o", "xs", 0], 1],
                         ["x7", ["o", "xs", 1], 1], ["x8", ["o", "big"], 8]], plan['slots']
assert plan['variables'] == 9
assert [r['status'] for r in out['records']] == ['READY', 'DUPLICATE', 'INVALID_TEST', 'INVALID_TEST']
assert out['records'][0]['model_result'] == {"xs": [1, 2], "big": 12345678901234567890}
assert out['corpus'][0]['inputs'] == {"a": True if False else 1, "b": 511, "c": (1 << 33) - 1, "d": (1 << 64) - 1}

# multi-entry: same inputs on two entries never merge
mod2 = {"name": "m2", "params": [["a", "W1"], ["b", "W9"], ["c", "W33"], ["d", "U64"]],
        "result": ["o", "Out"], "requires": None}
campaign2 = {"types": types, "modules": [mod, mod2], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
             "entries": ["m", "m2"], "machine": None,
             "runs": [
                {"entry": "m", "ktest": out['runs'][0]['ktest'] if 'runs' in out else b64(ktest([("x0", le(1,1)), ("x1", le(511,2)), ("x2", le((1<<33)-1,8)), ("x3", le((1<<64)-1,8)), ("x6", le(1,1)), ("x7", le(2,1)), ("x8", le(7,8))]))},
                {"entry": "m2", "ktest": b64(ktest([("x0", le(1,1)), ("x1", le(511,2)), ("x2", le((1<<33)-1,8)), ("x3", le((1<<64)-1,8)), ("x6", le(1,1)), ("x7", le(2,1)), ("x8", le(7,8))]))},
             ]}
out2 = run_campaign(campaign2)
assert [r['status'] for r in out2['records']] == ['READY', 'READY'], out2['records']
assert len(out2['corpus']) == 2

# pattern grammar battery (via requires match)
ptypes = [{"name": "S8", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 8}, {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
def pcheck(name, pattern, s, expect):
    pmod = {"name": "m", "params": [["s", "S8"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
            "requires": ["match", ["var", "s"], pattern]}
    chars = [ord(c) for c in s.ljust(8, '\x00')]
    seq = [("x%d" % (1 + i), le(chars[i], 1)) for i in range(8)] + [("x9", le(1, 1))]
    camp = {"types": ptypes, "modules": [pmod], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": None,
            "runs": [{"entry": "m", "ktest": b64(ktest(seq))}]}
    out = run_campaign(camp)
    got = out['records'][0]['status']
    assert (got == 'READY') == expect, (name, pattern, s, got, expect)

pcheck("union", "ab|cd|", "", True)
pcheck("union2", "ab|cd|", "ab", True)
pcheck("union3", "ab|cd|", "c", False)
pcheck("seq-star", "a[0-9]*b", "ab", True)
pcheck("seq-star2", "a[0-9]*b", "a09b", True)
pcheck("seq-star3", "a[0-9]*b", "a09c", False)
pcheck("nested", "(a|(bc))*d", "abcbcd", True)
pcheck("nested2", "(a|(bc))*d", "bad", False)
pcheck("esc-in-class", r"[\[\]x]*", "[]x[x]", True)
pcheck("esc-lit", r"\(a\|b\)", "(a|b)", True)
pcheck("esc-back", r"a\\b", "a\\b", True)
pcheck("class-range-esc", r"[\--0]*", "--0-", True)
pcheck("class-range-esc2", r"[\--0]*", "2", True)
pcheck("class-range-esc3", r"[\--0]*", ":", False)
pcheck("empty-pat", "", "", True)
pcheck("empty-pat2", "", "a", False)
pcheck("star-group-empty", "(()|a)*", "aaa", True)
pcheck("star-group-empty2", "(()|a)*", "b", False)
pcheck("dot-literal", "a.b", "a.b", True)
pcheck("dot-literal2", "a.b", "axb", False)
pcheck("star-postfix", "a**", "aaaa", True)
pcheck("alt-empty-alt", "x(|y)z", "xz", True)
pcheck("alt-empty-alt2", "x(|y)z", "xyz", True)
pcheck("big-class", "[a-zA-Z0-9_]*", "aZ_9", True)
pcheck("unicode-fail", "[a-c]*", "\u00e9", False)
pcheck("nul-char-match", "a[\\x00]" if False else "ab*", "a", True)
print("T8 OK")
EOF
